reason: Opponent's threats fly, so ground blockers barely help; swinging with both forces Hellkite to block one and puts the opponent at 2-3 instead of 3-7.

Killing a 3/3 flyer now slows a 6-per-turn air clock, but sacrificing a Treasure likely costs the Misty Mountains 6/6, so it is close.

An end-step bargained Torch, using a Treasure Conqueror locks anyway, exiles the 3/3 flyer, unlocks the Treasures and clears the way for the 6/6.
